program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((colors (grid-colors g 0))
         (row-out (for*/list ([color (in-list colors)]
                              [_ (in-range (count-where (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color)) (grid-cells g)))])
                    color)))
    (list (if (empty? row-out) (list 0) row-out))))
